#   apps       : The app region (directory + images). Format in kapps_fmt.h.
#   storage    : The user's FAT volume

#   app_pending: Development mailbox
#                so the bootloader will never boot it under any circumstances.
#                An image through it is at most 0x5FF000 (6 MB less the intent
#                sector); an OS image is bounded first by its 4 MB slot. The
#                Arduino core's Kode Dot entry uploads to this address
#                (build.flash_offset) with this ceiling (upload.maximum_size).
#   (the table itself sits at 0x8000; nvs starts at 0xB000 on purpose
#    two sectors between are free and a table change never has to move nvs)
# Executable code is not confined below the 16 MB mark: the cache maps 32-bit
# addresses (CONFIG_BOOTLOADER_CACHE_32BIT_ADDR_QUAD_FLASH in sdkconfig.board)
# so the apps region runs from the last OS slot all the way up to the FAT. Its
# base stays at 0xC40000
